Title: (LSJ) Dia de los Muertos and block Action

Messages.Author: xcver
Messages.Body:
Hi,

I was wondering about Dia de los Muertos. It say first referendum a
sabbat vampire calls. i read it as a referendum only occurs if is
initiated via a card or a Political Action is unblocked.

Does that mean that if I play DdlM and play a KRC which gets blocked
and another sabbat vamp plays another one not getting blocked it
automatically passes because it's the first referendum by a sabbat
vamp that turn?

Thanks,

Bernd

Dia de los Muertos
Type: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Master.
The first referendum a Sabbat vampire you control calls on this turn
automatically passes. Only one Dia de los Muertos may be played in a
game.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
xcver wrote:
> Hi,
>
> I was wondering about Dia de los Muertos. It say first referendum a
> sabbat vampire calls. i read it as a referendum only occurs if is
> initiated via a card or a Political Action is unblocked.
>
> Does that mean that if I play DdlM and play a KRC which gets blocked
> and another sabbat vamp plays another one not getting blocked it
> automatically passes because it's the first referendum by a sabbat
> vamp that turn?

It's the first referendum CALLED by a Sabbat vampire that turn, yes. (The
previous blocked action didn't call any referendum). So Dia works.
